annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅转发海关总署《关于促进综合保税区扩能提质的若干措施》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of the General Office of the State Council Forwarding the General Administration of Customs' Several Measures on Promoting Capacity Expansion and Quality Improvement of Comprehensive Bonded Zones
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅; 海关总署
annotation.summary_en: State Council General Office notice forwarding the General Administration of Customs' 24 measures to expand and upgrade comprehensive bonded zones, covering bonded repair, testing, remanufacturing, cross-border e-commerce, supply chain resilience, trade facilitation and smart customs supervision. AI is mentioned only as a supervision tool and a key technology area.
key_provisions_or_claims: Allows bonded repair, testing and remanufacturing with eased restrictions on old machinery imports
Differentiated conformity assessment for imported equipment used in AI, integrated circuits and other key technologies
Smart customs supervision using AI, IoT, digital twins and blockchain
Trust-based incentives for advanced-certified enterprises, including waived guarantees
Provincial governments responsible for zone development and safety
